title: ctfkit.migrate-wal/1
description: One record of the ctfkit migrate write-ahead log. Each record is its own 0600 file in the private 0700 run directory under os.UserCacheDir()/ctfkit/migrate/<run_id>, written to a temp file, fsynced and renamed, then the directory fsynced, before the mutation it describes. Images are files beside the records, referenced by path and SHA-256; a record never inlines state bytes or a credential (the writer's invariant; closed objects only refuse unknown members). Resume reads the records in seq order: done steps are skipped, an intent is resolved through its lookup, and an outcome that cannot be determined stops the unit.

operation_id.description: recorded before the mutation starts; the same id on the intent and on every later record of the operation

action.description: what the operation does, e.g. state_pull, replace_provider, write_files, reverse_replace_provider

status.description: intent: written before the mutation; done or failed: its known outcome; unknown: the lookup could not decide it, which is a stop state

compensates.description: operation_id of the operation this one reverses

lookup.description: how resume decides the outcome of an external mutation; a state serial is only meaningful with its lineage

images.description: one snapshot per distinct state or file per transaction

path.description: the image file, relative to the run directory

source.description: kind file: the config file it captures, relative to the scan root
